"};
    function renderPassportGuide() {
      return `<div class="rounded-2xl border border-[#D8E3D5] bg-white p-3 mb-4"><div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><button onclick="playKasroonVoice('passport-guide')" class="btn-primary px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold">🔊 أعد شرح الجواز بصوت كسرون</button><button onclick="stopKasroonVoice()" class="border rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#0F3D3E]">⏹ إيقاف الشرح</button></div><details class="mt-3"><summary class="cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold text-[#42685B]">نص شرح الجواز</summary><p class="mt-2 text-sm leading-loose text-[#0F3D3E]">${escapeStudentText(kasroonVoiceClips['passport-guide'].text)}</p></details></div>`;
    }
    function renderPassport() {
      return `<div class="flex gap-3 items-center mb-4"><div class="passport-mascot"><svg viewBox="0 0 150 170" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="kasroon-art">
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="157" rx="39" ry="7" fill="#0F3D3E" opacity=".13"/>
  <path d="M53 129 L45 149 L29 150 M95 129 L105 149 L120 148" fill="none" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M31 92 Q12 88 13 69 M118 89 Q137 77 130 59" fill="none" stroke="#148080" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="13" cy="66" r="8" fill="#F5C86B" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="3"/>
  <g class="kasroon-hand"><path d="M128 61 L124 48 M132 59 L138 46 M135 64 L146 59" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="132" cy="62" r="8" fill="#F5C86B" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="3"/></g>
  <circle cx="75" cy="87" r="48" fill="#52B9A5" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="4"/>
  <path d="M75 39 A48 48 0 0 1 123 87 H75 Z" fill="#F3A45F"/>
  <path d="M75 40 V132 M28 87 H122" fill="none" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="2" opacity=".4"/>
  <path d="M49 43 Q47 22 63 30 Q66 9 79 26 Q95 16 99 39" fill="#0F3D3E"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="77" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#fff"/><ellipse cx="91" cy="77" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="79" r="4" fill="#0F3D3E"/><circle cx="90" cy="79" r="4" fill="#0F3D3E"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="92" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#F5B9A4"/><ellipse cx="105" cy="92" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#F5B9A4"/>
  <path d="M62 94 Q75 108 88 94" fill="#fff" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="59" y="111" width="33" height="25" rx="9" fill="#FAF8F3" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="75.5" y="129" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F3D3E">¾</text>
</svg></div><div><p class="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#0F3D3E]">${state.studentName?escapeStudentText(state.studentName)+'، ':''}كل محطة حكاية وإنجاز!</p><p class="text-xs text-[#42685B] mt-1">جمعت ${state.completedTasks.size} من 8 أختام في هذه الجلسة.</p></div></div>${renderPassportGuide()}<div class="passport-grid">${STAGES.filter(stage=>stage.id>1).map(stage=>{const done=state.completedTasks.has(stage.id);return `<button class="passport-stamp ${done?'earned':''}" onclick="closeModal('passportModal');goToStage(${stage.id})" aria-label="${stage.title}، ${done?'ختم مكتسب':'لم يكتمل بعد'}"><span class="stamp-icon" aria-hidden="true">${stage.icon}</span><strong>${stage.title}</strong><small>${done?'✓ ختم الإنجاز':'أكمل المحطة لتحصل على ختمها'}</small></button>`;}).join('')}</div>`;
    }
    function openPassport() {document.getElementById('passportContent').innerHTML=renderPassport();openModal('passportModal');playKasroonVoice('passport-guide');}
    function graduationScore() {return QUIZ_QUESTIONS.reduce((sum,q,i)=>sum+(state.quizAnswers[i]===q.correct?1:0),0);}
    let graduationTimer=null;
    function celebrateGraduation() {
      document.body.classList.remove('celebrating');clearTimeout(graduationTimer);
      if(!access.motion && !window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){document.body.classList.add('celebrating');graduationTimer=setTimeout(()=>document.body.classList.remove('celebrating'),2900);}
      if(soundEnabled && state.encouragementEnabled)playKasroonVoice('praise-1');
    }
    function updateCertificateName(value) {setStudentName(value);const label=document.getElementById('certificateStudentName');if(label)label.textContent=state.studentName.trim()||'مستكشف الكسور';}
    function printJourneyCertificate() {
      if(!state.quizSubmitted)return;
      document.body.classList.add('printing-certificate');
      window.addEventListener('afterprint',()=>document.body.classList.remove('printing-certificate'),{once:true});
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>window.print());
    }
    function saveJourneyCertificate() {
      if(!state.quizSubmitted)return;
      const name=escapeStudentText(state.studentName.trim()||'مستكشف الكسور');
      const svg=`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1600" height="1000" viewBox="0 0 1600 1000"><rect width="1600" height="1000" fill="#FFFDF4"/><rect x="35" y="35" width="1530" height="930" rx="28" fill="none" stroke="#B99B48" stroke-width="5"/><rect x="58" y="58" width="1484" height="884" rx="18" fill="none" stroke="#DFD2A1" stroke-width="2"/><g transform="translate(110 330) scale(2)">
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="157" rx="39" ry="7" fill="#0F3D3E" opacity=".13"/>
  <path d="M53 129 L45 149 L29 150 M95 129 L105 149 L120 148" fill="none" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M31 92 Q12 88 13 69 M118 89 Q137 77 130 59" fill="none" stroke="#148080" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="13" cy="66" r="8" fill="#F5C86B" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="3"/>
  <g class="kasroon-hand"><path d="M128 61 L124 48 M132 59 L138 46 M135 64 L146 59" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="132" cy="62" r="8" fill="#F5C86B" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="3"/></g>
  <circle cx="75" cy="87" r="48" fill="#52B9A5" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="4"/>
  <path d="M75 39 A48 48 0 0 1 123 87 H75 Z" fill="#F3A45F"/>
  <path d="M75 40 V132 M28 87 H122" fill="none" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="2" opacity=".4"/>
  <path d="M49 43 Q47 22 63 30 Q66 9 79 26 Q95 16 99 39" fill="#0F3D3E"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="77" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#fff"/><ellipse cx="91" cy="77" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="79" r="4" fill="#0F3D3E"/><circle cx="90" cy="79" r="4" fill="#0F3D3E"/>
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="92" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#F5B9A4"/><ellipse cx="105" cy="92" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#F5B9A4"/>
  <path d="M62 94 Q75 108 88 94" fill="#fff" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="59" y="111" width="33" height="25" rx="9" fill="#FAF8F3" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="75.5" y="129" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial,sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#0F3D3E">¾</text>
</g><g font-family="Arial,sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0F3D3E"><text x="900" y="180" font-size="26" direction="rtl">رحلة الكسور العادية · مع كسرون</text><text x="900" y="280" font-size="66" font-weight="bold" direction="rtl">شهادة إنجاز</text><text x="900" y="370" font-size="30" direction="rtl">يقدّم كسرون هذه الشهادة إلى</text><text x="900" y="490" font-size="60" font-weight="bold" fill="#148080" direction="rtl">${name}</text><text x="900" y="590" font-size="30" direction="rtl">لإتمام رحلة الكسور العادية</text><text x="900" y="670" font-size="28" direction="rtl">الدرجة: ${graduationScore()} من 6 · النجوم: ${state.stars.size} من 5</text><text x="900" y="790" font-size="25" direction="rtl">إعداد وإشراف: أ. أمل عبدالله العفيفي</text><text x="900" y="855" font-size="24" fill="#785C9A" direction="rtl">كل جزء له حكاية… وكل محاولة إنجاز!</text></g></svg>`;
      const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([svg],{type:'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8'}));
      const image=new Image();
      image.onload=()=>{
        const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=1600;canvas.height=1000;
        const context=canvas.getContext('2d');context.drawImage(image,0,0);
        canvas.toBlob(blob=>{
          if(!blob){URL.revokeObjectURL(url);showToast('يمكنك حفظ الشهادة من زر الطباعة بصيغة PDF');return;}
          const png=URL.createObjectURL(blob),link=document.createElement('a');link.href=png;link.download='kasroon-certificate.png';link.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(png),1000);URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        },'image/png');
      };
      image.onerror=()=>{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);showToast('تعذّر حفظ الصورة. استخدم طباعة أو حفظ PDF.');};image.src=url;
    }

    // ---------- SVG Fraction Helpers ----------
    function renderPieSVG(num, den, size = 76, fill = '#D96B43', empty = '#F4EFE4') {
      fill=denominatorColor(den,fill);
      const cx = size / 2, cy = size / 2, r = size * 0.42;
      if (den <= 0) return '';
      if (num >= den) {
        return `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 ${size} ${size}" class="mx-auto">
          <circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="${r}" fill="${fill}" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="2"/>
        </svg>`;
      }
      let paths = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < den; i++) {
        const a1 = (i * 2 * Math.PI) / den - Math.PI / 2;
        const a2 = ((i + 1) * 2 * Math.PI) / den - Math.PI / 2;
        const x1 = cx + r * Math.cos(a1), y1 = cy + r * Math.sin(a1);
        const x2 = cx + r * Math.cos(a2), y2 = cy + r * Math.sin(a2);
        const largeArc = (a2 - a1) > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
        const color = i < num ? fill : empty;
        paths += `<path d="M ${cx} ${cy} L ${x1.toFixed(2)} ${y1.toFixed(2)} A ${r} ${r} 0 ${largeArc} 1 ${x2.toFixed(2)} ${y2.toFixed(2)} Z" fill="${color}" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="1.6"/>`;
      }
      return `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 ${size} ${size}" class="mx-auto">${paths}</svg>`;
    }

    function renderBarSVG(num, den, width = 150, height = 28, fill = '#148080') {
      fill=denominatorColor(den,fill);
      const w = width / den;
      let rects = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < den; i++) {
        rects += `<rect x="${(i * w).toFixed(2)}" y="1" width="${w.toFixed(2)}" height="${height - 2}" fill="${i < num ? fill : '#F4EFE4'}" stroke="#0F3D3E" stroke-width="1.5"/>`;
      }
      return `<svg width="${width}" height="${height}" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" class="mx-auto rounded">${rects}</svg>`;
    }

    function fracHTML(n, d) {
      return `<span class="frac" data-denominator="${d}" style="color:${denominatorColor(d)}"><span class="num">${n}</span><span class="den">${d}</span></span>`;
    }
